scripts.check: bun run test:core && bun run check:frontend
scripts.check:frontend: bun run typecheck && bun run test:frontend && bun run build:frontend
scripts.typecheck: bun run zigeffect:workbench:typecheck && bun run zigeffect:grpc:web:typecheck && bun run zigeffect-site:typecheck
scripts.test:frontend: bun run zigeffect:workbench:test && bun run zigeffect:grpc:web:test-only && bun run zigeffect-site:test
scripts.build:frontend: bun run zigeffect:workbench:build && bun run zigeffect-site:build
scripts.test:std: cd packages/zigeffect-std && zig build test && zig build examples
scripts.test:cli: cd packages/zigeffect-cli && zig build test && zig build integration-test
scripts.zigeffect:grpc:web:generate: cd packages/zigeffect-grpc && bunx @bufbuild/buf lint && bunx @bufbuild/buf build && bunx @bufbuild/buf generate
scripts.zigeffect:grpc:web:test: bun run zigeffect:grpc:web:typecheck && bun run zigeffect:grpc:web:test-only
